views.student: V_final BRIGHT from the frozen P3b-R R1 random-response contract
views.teacher: V_dense BRIGHT on the identical canonical grid and exact P3b-R support_random
views.pairing: same phase, cap, core, context lattice, authoritative galaxies, outer split, and exact binary P3b-R support_random M; stage counts and ntilde-derived contrast may differ

architecture.teacher: EMA copy of student encoder only; stop-gradient; no target head
architecture.predictor: separate pointwise convolutional predictor at each aligned layer
architecture.deployment: student encoder plus student-only ordered-increment target head

masking.support_role: hidden exact binary P3b-R M metadata; never a model input

technical_canary_auxiliary_gate.policy: the exhaustive population rate is gated separately; the finite 500-update technical canary uses an integer count so one rare auxiliary-invalid core does not fail solely because 1/500 exceeds the population-rate threshold

masking.cluster_policy: seeded first supported voxel plus farthest-point seeds; balanced nearest-unselected supported voxels per seed
masking.downsample_policy: ANY propagation through the U-Net MaxPool3d(2,ceil_mode=True) hierarchy
masking.target_domain: exact support_random==1 inside the authoritative core; 25 percent integer-rounded into four compact clusters when auxiliary-valid
masking.auxiliary_invalid_policy: retain the core and authoritative target loss; supervised_masked, masked_reconstruction, and jepa use unmasked V_final, while response_only retains its registered globally zeroed cosmological-signal input; every arm uses an all-zero target mask and zero auxiliary terms when exact-support minima fail or either aligned layer has fewer than two pooled targets
masking.fallback: no core is dropped; only the matched auxiliary intervention is disabled under the registered auxiliary-invalid policy

objective.alignment: smooth-L1 between layer-normalized predictor and stop-gradient teacher targets
objective.spread: VICReg hinge on per-channel standard deviation of student target latents

optimization.scheduler: CosineAnnealingLR over the identical full-epoch update budget

matched_arms.supervised_masked: same student, examples, masks, weights and updates; target loss only
matched_arms.masked_reconstruction: same student and masks; target loss plus reconstruction of the two masked final-view signal channels
matched_arms.response_only: same target head and examples, with both cosmological signal channels zeroed and response retained
matched_arms.jepa: same student and masks; target loss plus dense-view EMA latent prediction and collapse regularization

promotion.primary: deployable student ph006 macro-shell R2(lambda1) gain >= 0.03 over the matched supervised control
